summary: 已用同配置四帧GPU对照确认净改善：离线OIDN前将opaque历史上限从3改为1，右侧墙面和道路斑驳显著减少，主要窗框/饰条/路沿轮廓保留，首帧最终图逐位一致。收录为有限离线候选；细小石材纹理仍偏软，四帧不代表长动态验收。
recommended_for: Current cloud-on offline OIDN export using this exact captured scene/preset; existing runtime defaults remain unchanged.

root_cause.raw_sampling: Sparse bright samples already exist in current-frame HDR. In the measured right-side region the largest frame1 sample has luminance0.1557791978 both before and after history; no brightness clamp was introduced.
root_cause.history: Short-history mixing retains old bright positions and changes the spatial noise distribution. Right opaque-region energy changes only+0.0193%/-0.3888% in frames1/2. Those startup frames do not run luminance rejection or sigma clipping, so clipping is not the source of their new mottling.
root_cause.reprojection: Actual nearest-pixel reprojection includes local many-to-one reuse, affecting1.92%/2.47% of changed pixels in frames1/2. This explains some local duplication but does not establish a motion-vector/indexing error or account for all broad mottling.
root_cause.OIDN_response: With identical CPU RT HDR HIGH settings and inputScale256, current-frame input denoises substantially cleaner than history-mixed input. A neutral-opaque-only offline replacement preserves actual sky/water/rain and reproduces the improvement. The subsequent real GPU cap1 run confirms it. This identifies a harmful interaction in the current history-before-OIDN pipeline, not a universal claim about all temporal filters or OIDN.

minimal_change.scope: clouds on; offline OIDN candidate only

measured_local.performance_claim: Reported timings only; one run per configuration does not establish a speedup.

remaining: Fine stone and facade texture remains soft after color-only OIDN; no clean reference establishes detail-perfect denoising.
Four frames span about0.05seconds; no long-trajectory stability guarantee.
Current guide-domain policy is conservative.96pixels specifies model context, not a general requirement that every context pixel have one reliable material. No further mask restrictions were added.
This repair changes an offline export preset; no realtime denoiser integration or60fps claim.
